checkpoint_policy: The manuscript table and curves use the final-epoch last.pt result. best.pt was validated separately and is retained only in best_checkpoint_validation_results.csv as a supplementary diagnostic.
evaluation: Ultralytics validation split, same data YAML and image size as AG-YOLO

differences_from_yolo_hvs_paper.batch: 32 here versus 8 reported in the paper
differences_from_yolo_hvs_paper.momentum: 0.937 here versus 0.9 reported in the paper
differences_from_yolo_hvs_paper.amp: disabled here; the paper does not disclose AMP
differences_from_yolo_hvs_paper.epochs: 300 here; the paper does not disclose epoch count
differences_from_yolo_hvs_paper.imgsz: 640 here; the paper does not disclose training image size
differences_from_yolo_hvs_paper.dataset: Night-Drone Vehicle subset here versus full DroneVehicle in the paper
